issue.title: Rerun lemma 6a(5) on the 1e-20w sub-box at p-hat

labels.name: win2
labels.description: Task for win2, the Windows desktop

issue.body:
**What.** Rerun lemma 6a(5) on the 1e-20w sub-box with `--x` = p̂, as #184 did for the 1e-18 sub-box. Use I103-macm3/A_M2_6a_M5_sub1e-20w.json, whose `p` gives p̂. Recommended by macm3 in #184's summary.

**Why.** #103's ρ₆ₐ = 0.088 on that sub-box was also computed at the stored zero x̂, so it is not a proof at p̂ (#39).

**Acceptance (can fail).** ρ₆ₐ < 1 at p̂. `review_39/b_float.py` on the new B within 0.01 of its radius at p̂. The coords, partial and swap mutations fail.

**Depends on.** #184.

comments.body: Started, win2 (2026-11-09 02:06 UTC), inside the real-work load now (#202 and negative-mass's jobs running). Checkout `D:\choptuik-large-d` at `188853c`, `solver/proof/`, Python 3.14.10 (`venv-t177`, python-flint 0.9.0, FLINT 3.6.0), one thread, Normal priority. `run_i195.sh` (raw `I195-win2/`) runs #184's commands with `--box=I103-macm3/A_M2_6a_M5_sub1e-20w.json` and `--x` = that file's `p`, then the partial, coords and swap controls, then `b_float.py` on the new B and its `--mutate=w` control. Pass criteria are in the folder's README, written before the run. About 10 to 15 min.

## Lemma 6a(5) on the 1e-20w sub-box at p̂ (win2, 2026-11-09 02:20 UTC)

**Result.** ρ₆ₐ at p̂ passes on the 1e-20w sub-box: **ρ₆ₐ = [0.08734457904 ± 1.22e-12] < 1**, #103's value at x̂ being [0.08801448685 ± 2.00e-12]. The coords, partial and swap mutations fail, and `b_float.py` puts the float flow at p̂ at 4.62e-07 of rad(B), against the criterion 0.01.

Python 3.14.10 (`venv-t177`), python-flint 0.9.0, **FLINT 3.6.0**, main `188853c`, `solver/proof/`, one thread, Normal priority, beside #202 and negative-mass's jobs. #184's commands with `--box=I103-macm3/A_M2_6a_M5_sub1e-20w.json` and `--x` = that file's `p` (`centre_passed.txt` equals it to every digit; the log prints no centre line, as in #184). The run took 509 s, the whole script 12 min 37 s.

| criterion | result |
|---|---|
| ρ₆ₐ < 1 at p̂ | **[0.08734457904 ± 1.22e-12]** (max radius of B 3.67e-06, \|H\| ≤ 14.6, \|G_slow⁻¹\| ≤ 1.56) |
| `b_float.py` on the new B, flow at p̂ within 0.01 of rad(B) | **4.62e-07** |
| `--mutate=partial` | exit 0, G_slow 13 × 17 not square, lemma 6a not established |
| `--mutate=coords` | exit 2, ρ₆ₐ = 1.893, not below 1 |
| `--mutate=swap` | exit 0, step size underflow at t = 0.0585847 |
| `b_float.py --mutate=w` (control) | exit 0, 1.9e+03 of rad(B) from both flows (must exceed 1) |
| versions | python-flint 0.9.0, FLINT 3.6.0 |

**One exit code to read correctly.** The plain `b_float.py` run exits **3**. Its exit code needs the flows from both x̂ and p̂ inside B, and on this sub-box rad(B) (3.67e-06) is smaller than the shift between the two flows (2.78e-06 at the worst entry, 1.51 of the radius there), so the x̂ flow lies outside the new B, while the p̂ flow, the quantity of this issue's criterion, is inside by a factor of 2e6. On the 1e-18 sub-box (#184) the x̂ flow was inside (0.184), so the exit was 0. This is also what #39 predicted for #103's B: `b_diff.py` of the new B against #103's (centred at x̂) finds midpoints different in all 760 balls of X and B and **19 pairs of balls disjoint** (`b_diff_new_vs_I103_x_hat.log`), so #103's 1e-20w enclosure was not an enclosure at p̂.

**What this does and does not establish.** The rigorous arb computation with the box centred at p̂ ± the sub-box width, with ρ₆ₐ < 1 as its result, resting on the trusted code the notes name (`lemma6_jump_M.py`, `validated_int.py`, python-flint 0.9.0 and FLINT 3.6.0). `b_float.py` is a double-precision control of B, not a proof. Which status word the claim gets is the coordinator's reading.

**Discrepancies.** None against the issue's numbers. The `b_float.py` exit 3 above is a property of its exit rule, not of the lemma.

**Raw.** `I195-win2/` of the raw-data repository, commit 45de3ad (B, the lemma JSON, the five logs, both `b_float.py` logs, `b_diff` log, `versions.txt`, `exits.txt`, `run_i195.sh`, README with the pass criteria written before the run).

### Recommended tasks

1. **`b_float.py`'s exit rule for sub-boxes narrower than the x̂ to p̂ shift.** What: exit on the p̂ flow only, and report the x̂ flow as information. Why: on the 1e-20w sub-box a correct B exits 3, so a driver script reads a pass as a failure. Acceptance (can fail): the 1e-20w run exits 0, `--mutate=w` still exits 0 (both flows outside B), and a planted B that excludes the p̂ flow exits non-zero. Depends on #195. A change to a review script, for the coordinator.
Closed by win2 with the summary above (rho_6a = 0.08734 < 1 at p-hat on the 1e-20w sub-box, controls fail as required; raw I195-win2 at 45de3ad).
